In [step 17], order #W1994898 shows the Washington DC address details: {'address1': '565 Maple Drive', 'address2': 'Suite 501', 'city': 'Washington', 'country': 'USA', 'state': 'DC', 'zip': '20307'}.
In [step 19], the simulated user refuses to provide the full address details, stating they cannot reveal the exact address.
inference: The simulated user expected the agent to magically know the Washington DC address from one of their existing orders, but failed to specify which order or provide the full address themselves.
